name: brigade
description: Team messaging between Claude Code sessions of different people and machines, through a pluggable adapter CLI

adapter_path.title: Adapter executable
adapter_path.description: Path to the Brigade adapter CLI (default: brigade-supabase found on PATH). Never a shell command.

profile.title: Adapter profile
profile.description: Adapter profile name; each profile is bound to exactly one team

poll_on_prompt.title: Poll for messages on each prompt
poll_on_prompt.description: Fallback for hosts without an inbox socket: fetch unread messages when you submit a prompt
